router_distinctions: Tier escalation: Use the cheapest tier (lowest priority) that can handle the task. Escalate to a higher tier only when the task clearly requires more capability. Lightweight vs heavyweight: Use lightweight tiers for conversational replies, factual recall, short answers, and simple tool invocations. Use heavyweight tiers for reasoning, analysis, structured output, code work, and multi-step tasks. Use the highest tier only for system-wide architecture, multi-component design, or holding many constraints simultaneously. Read-only vs read-write: Use write-capable tiers ONLY when the user explicitly requests creating, editing, deleting, or modifying files, running tools, or executing actions. Questions about code or asking for suggestions use read-only tiers even if they mention files. Agent tier: Use the agent tier for complex multi-step tasks that benefit from parallel execution by multiple specialized sub-agents (research + implementation, multi-file coordinated changes, tasks requiring different expertise areas simultaneously). When in doubt: Default to the lowest-priority enabled tier. Fast and cheap is better than over-escalating.

tiers.name: haiku_r
tiers.router_label: Casual conversation, simple factual questions, short summaries, translations, dictionary lookups, weather-style queries, small talk, jokes

tiers.name: haiku_rw
tiers.router_label: Running scheduled jobs, invoking tools (reminders, timers, web search), simple file creation, quick one-line edits, toggling settings

tiers.name: sonnet_r
tiers.router_label: Code review, debugging analysis, explaining complex concepts, comparing options, writing structured content (emails, docs), research synthesis, data interpretation

tiers.name: sonnet_rw
tiers.router_label: Editing code files, implementing features, fixing bugs in code, creating scripts, modifying configurations, writing tests, multi-file text changes

tiers.name: opus_r
tiers.router_label: Architecture design, system-level reasoning, complex trade-off analysis, long-form strategic planning, reviewing entire codebases, deep technical research

tiers.name: opus_rw
tiers.router_label: Large-scale refactoring across multiple files, implementing complex features with many moving parts, redesigning system architecture, building new modules from scratch

tiers.name: agent
tiers.description: Multi-agent coordinator for complex multi-step tasks requiring parallel work by multiple specialized agents
